title: Peter Jackson - Vacation - Feat Chrissy Spratt
htmlContent: Toronto, ON (August 21, 2017) - Award winning rapper and heart Radio Future Star Winner, Peter Jackson is ready to release the second single from his “Married to Success” project, “Vacation” produced by DJ Marley Waters. The single features 90 Nickel latest signs pop singer Chrissy Spratt, who is recognized for her smooth covers of pop, rap songs & has over 3 million YouTube hits and a combined total of 50,000 followers on her social platforms. Inspiration for the single came from the thought of being on holiday, enjoying life and just having fun with the flow of the music. Producer, DJ Marley Waters has crafted hits for artist like Kranium, Tinashe and Schoolboy. The video for “Vacation” will start shooting early this September and released later that month. This release comes later the success of Peter Jackson’s first single “On a Wave”. The single hit number 30 on CHR and was added to 25 CHR stations across Canada. Jackson also named a national radio campaign with the single being added to heavy rotation on all Virgin Radio Stations across Canada. Jackson has also been on the road touring with other well-known rappers like French Montana, Juicy J, Jadakiss, Snoop Dogg, Machine Gun Kelly, Wu-Tang Clan, Akon and more.   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hj8zZEbdqYc&feature=youtu.be
